note: Canteen (2020 pano hotspot 'Kantin'): long single-storey gable-roofed block north of Block C, between the round bed (W) and the east service road; beige horizontal siding with one brown band, red brick-tile plinth, dark-brown roof with boxed eaves, a glazed porch at the west gable. Frame x along the south wall from its SW corner (sports frame u axis, -2.2 deg), y north, z above FFL. Only the west gable is photographed (070410255 t=44-48/65.5 s): no windows modelled on S/E/N (unknown, see photo_requests).
